item.title: Nigeria’s payment data must stay onshore by January 2027: Here’s what that means for data centres
item.summary: The Central Bank of Nigeria issued a circular on 15 June ordering banks, fintechs, mobile money operators and other payment system participants to store and manage locally generated payment transaction data inside the country. The post Nigeria’s payment data must stay onshore by January 2027: Here’s what that means for data centres appeared first on Capacity .
